title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games Anime Reveals More Cast in Main Promo Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Eri Ejima 's Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games ( Tai Ari Deshita: Ojō-sama wa Kakutō Game Nante Shinai ) manga revealed more cast and the main promotional video on Friday. The below video previews both the opening and ending theme songs.
author: ANN

title: Victoria of Many Faces Anime Reveals Short Promo Video Highlighting Victoria, Jeffrey
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a new short "Victoria and Jeffrey version" promotional video on Friday. The anime will host an online advanced screening program on June 27 at 3:00 p.m.
author: ANN

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects Anime Reveals 3rd Promo Video, More Cast, Early Debut on Prime Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Fuurou 's The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects ( Ryōmin 0-nin Start no Henkyō Ryōshu-sama ) light novel series revealed a third promotional video on Friday, along with more cast members.
author: ANN

title: 20th Anniversary Sgt. Frog Film Reveals Opening Scene
content: The official YouTube channel for Shin Gekijōban ☆ Keroro Gunsō Fukkatsu Shite Sokkō Chikyū Metsubō no Kiki de Arimasu! (New Sgt. Frog the Movie: The Earth Is in Mortal Peril as Soon as We Come Back!), the new 20th anniversary anime film project , began streaming its opening scene on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Rich Girl Caretaker TV Anime Reveals 2nd Promo Video, More Cast
content: The official website for the anime adaptation of author Yusaku Sakaishi and illustrator Sakura Miwabe 's Rich Girl Caretaker ( Saijo no Osewa ) light novel series revealed the show's second promotional video and more cast on Friday Kentarō Kumagai joins the cast as Katsuya Taishō.
author: ANN

title: 'Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama' Unveils Supporting Cast, Third Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Fuurou 's Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama ( The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects: The Blue-Horned Maiden ) unveiled supporting cast, second key visual (pictured), and third promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Announces 5 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga announced cast members for five characters who shape the life journey of the main character Yoichi Isagi on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Takeru Hokazono 's Kagurabachi manga revealed on Friday that Tomokazu Seki is joining the anime's cast as Kunishige Rokuhira, the protagonist Chihiro's father.
author: ANN

title: Red River Anime's New Video Previews Hiroki Nanami's Opening Song
content: The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga began streaming the full promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video previews the anime's opening theme song "Akatsuki no Sora" (Dawn Sky) by Hiroki Nanami .
author: ANN
